mapper.select: SELECT 'COLOR' AS group_code, c.v AS code, count(*) AS count FROM tb_user_profile p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.colors) AS c(v) GROUP BY c.v UNION ALL SELECT 'STYLE', m.v, count(*) FROM tb_user_profile p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.moods) AS m(v) GROUP BY m.v

SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user_profile
WHERE #{code} = ANY (colors) WHERE #{code} = ANY (moods) WHERE FALSE

SELECT u.user_id FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.user_id IN #{id} AND COALESCE((p.notify ->> 'dMinus1')::boolean, TRUE) ORDER BY u.user_id
